initial_observation.proposal_tiling: unchanged full frame plus four fixed 40-percent corner tiles
initial_observation.initial_track: unchanged depth-pose symmetric mask coverage ranking

action_roster.motion_score: translation multiplied by square root of bidirectional depth-visible fractions

action_utility.hypothesis_support: For each current Top-3 mask track, maximum bbox IoU between its depth-visible projection and the generic proposal set in the action view.
action_utility.information_gain_score: mean hypothesis support multiplied by the range of hypothesis support
action_utility.tie_break: higher mean support, then higher mutual covisibility, then lower frame index
action_utility.target_truth_access: No target geometry, target bbox, target identity score, or target IoU before the single action is selected.

confirmation_gate.requirements: Both initial views and the one selected action must contain a proposal with IoU at least 0.8, and unchanged 3D-track Top-3 must retain such a proposal in all three views.

decision: Acquire and screen queue row 4 exactly. If source-evaluable, freeze its exact three reference views and two initial query views before RGB/model access, run the fixed information-gain action once, and apply this gate without changing thresholds, candidate budget, proposal generator, track ranker, or action utility.
claim_boundary: A pass would be one source-family-disjoint confirmation of bounded portal-region candidate recovery under an offline recorded-view action oracle. It would not establish portal ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, physical arrival, handoff, user benefit, reliability, deployment, or safety.
